resources.string: No packs yet. Create one and add photos, videos or GIFs to it.
%1$d stickers · WhatsApp needs %2$d–%3$d. Tap a sticker to choose emojis or delete it.
Preparing sticker… (%1$d left — videos can take 5–30 s)
Frame rate reduced to fit 500 KB.
⚠️ Low quality: this part did not fit 500 KB at good quality. Delete it and pick a shorter part for a sharper sticker.
The pack and its stickers are removed from this app. Stickers already added to WhatsApp may disappear there too.
This pack is already in WhatsApp; the update was cancelled. Press “Update in WhatsApp” again to send the changes.
Fix these before adding to WhatsApp:
Choose 1–3 emojis. WhatsApp uses them to suggest this sticker.

WhatsApp doesn\'t allow sending a single sticker to a chat (it arrives as a photo). Instead the sticker goes into the \"Quick stickers\" pack: add the pack to WhatsApp once, then just confirm the update for each new sticker.
Add to quick pack → WhatsApp Business
Added to \"%1$s\" (%2$d stickers). WhatsApp needs at least 3 stickers per pack: make %3$d more and it will be added to WhatsApp.
✅ In WhatsApp. It appears inside the pack in your sticker panel.
The pack is already in WhatsApp; the update wasn\'t confirmed. Tap \"Update in WhatsApp\" to make the new sticker appear.
Share with another app (arrives as a photo in WhatsApp)
WhatsApp keeps the stickers you receive in chats in a folder. Allow access to that folder once: on the next screen tap “Use this folder”.
The app only reads this folder. Stickers are copied as they are — no recompression, no quality loss.
This does not look like the WhatsApp sticker folder; stickers may be missing.
No stickers found in this folder.
Stickers over 500 KB are being recompressed (a few seconds each).
%1$d stickers were recompressed to fit the 500 KB limit.
When a whole pack is shared in a chat, WhatsApp saves it in a separate folder. Allow that folder too to see complete packs.
No stickers yet. Make some in DVScreator and they appear here.
Stickers you send appear here. Pick a pack above.
This text field doesn\'t accept stickers.

Send stickers without adding a pack: in a chat switch the keyboard to “DVScreator Sticker” and tap a sticker; it is sent as a sticker. This keyboard doesn\'t type and doesn\'t read what you type; Android shows a generic warning for every keyboard.
✅ Keyboard enabled. In a chat pick “DVScreator Sticker” from the keyboard switcher; tap the keyboard icon at the very bottom to go back.
Saved to Pictures/DVScreator. In Samsung Keyboard: sticker tab → + (Create sticker) → pick this image.
Make it, send it with the keyboard
A pack to add to WhatsApp
